newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK population 6.31 million at end-June - gov't.
newsitem.headline: HK population 6.31 million at end-June - gov't.

text.p: The population of Hong Kong was estimated at 6.31 million at the end of June, up 2.5 percent from the same time in 1995, the Census and Statistics Department said on Tuesday.
The estimate was based on results of a census conducted in March 1996, it said in a statement.
Between mid-1995 and mid-1996, there were 66,900 births and 31,300 deaths in the territory and the natural increase accounted for 23 percent of the growth.
There was also a net inflow of 119,300 people within the same period, the statement said.
The British territory reverts to Chinese rule at midnight on June 30, 1997.
